verdict.rationale: Window snapping and tiling is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions window snapping, tiling, or predefined layouts. The closest item is a community note about Flatpak window resize controls not mapping, which is a Flatpak complaint and says nothing about tiling.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snap and tile windows into predefined layouts for multitasking
